data.title: Indian filmmaker Anuparna Roy: blocked at home, feted in Europe
data.description: VENICE — Independent Indian filmmaker Anuparna Roy, whose first film won a top prize at the Venice Film Festival last year, told Agence France-Presse ( AFP ) that it had been blocked by censors and would not be shown in her home country.

data.title: Japan feminist theatre fights misogyny in 'cute' fashion
data.description: TOKYO — Donning doll-like dresses with voluminous skirts, young women on stage roar in rage about rape and sexism they experienced in Japan, using theatre and "cute" fashion to denounce male-dominated society.

data.title: The paradox of death
data.description: Uruphong Raksasad has returned with the camera to capture the vanishing countryside in Thailand, a place where generations once shared history, values and resources, though not all equally benefited from it. In Songsakan, villagers join a funeral procession to transport a body to the cremation ground. Through this, Uruphong quietly observes his childhood memory in the midst of change.

data.title: Stray Kids' 'World Tour '  comes to Impact Arena for 2 nights
data.description: Stray Kids will bring their "World Tour " to Impact Arena for two spectacular nights. Live Nation Tero announced the global K-pop powerhouse will perform in Bangkok on Jan 16-17, with tickets available via ticketmaster.co.th from Sept 21.

data.title: Running on empty
data.description: The Runner, a new thriller film on Prime Video, has the former Wonder Woman Gal Gadot playing a mother forced into a madman's game to save her son with one simple task -- running.

data.title: Israeli-made film about Gaza gets 25-minute ovation at Venice premiere
data.description: VENICE - A chilling new documentary about Israel's AI-powered mass killing of civilians in Gaza from two Oscar-winning Israeli filmmakers received a 25-minute ovation at its premiere at the Venice Film Festival on Thursday.

data.title: New movies out this week: Sept 11-17
data.description: Six new releases that hit cinemas in Thailand this week.

data.title: ‘Practical Magic 2’ is more practical than magical
data.description: Practical Magic 2 (2026) marks a cinematic return to the world of witches and magic, 28 years after the original. The Owens sisters are back, not only to confront their dark family curse, but also to learn how to stop being overprotective parents and finally embrace who they are.

data.title: A new thread in Thai heritage
data.description: Thailand’s textile heritage took centre stage at the Authors’ Lounge of the Mandarin Oriental, Bangkok, where 27 international delegates of Miss International Queen 2026 stepped onto the runway in contemporary interpretations of royal Thai costumes.

data.title: Bayeux Tapestry ‘mania’ sweeps UK
data.description: LONDON - London’s sold-out Bayeux Tapestry exhibition will open on Thursday to a British public gripped by “mania” as the mediaeval artwork depicting the Norman conquest of England goes on display outside France for the first time.

data.title: Idris Elba brings his dance-music alias to Bangkok
data.description: Performing as "Idris", the internationally acclaimed DJ and producer Idris Elba brings Sound International to Cloud 11 Theatre for one night only on Sept 26.

data.title: New releases for your streaming pleasure: Sept 9-15
data.description: Looking for a title to binge-watch this weekend? Here's our pick!

data.title: 9 Temples To Heaven chosen as Thailand's Oscars entry
data.description: 9 Temples To Heaven, directed by Sompot Chidgasornpongse, has been selected by the National Federation of Motion Pictures and Contents Associations as Thailand's entry for the 99th Academy Awards in the Best International Feature Film category.

data.title: Sounds Of Wireless stages  evening of classical guitarists
data.description: Six guitarists from different generations will deliver their expressive range and versatility during "Sounds Of Wireless: Classical Guitar Conversations – From Solos To Sextet", at 140 Wireless, Witthayu Road, on Saturday at 4pm.

data.title: Hungary's Be My Dad kicks off  Contemporary World Film Series
data.description: <p>The 2026 Contemporary World Film Series is back with Be My Dad (Szia, &Eacute;letem!), a thought-provoking comedy from Hungary which will be screened at TK Park, 8th floor of CentralWorld, Ratchadamri Road, on Sept 20 at 4pm.</p>

data.title: 'Are we ready?' Oasis film captures band's frosty reunion
data.description: VENICE - A new film about Oasis's historic 2025 world tour, premiering Saturday in Venice, captures the frosty reunion of the British band's Gallagher brothers -- and shows how their children have become the "cement" in their volatile relationship.

data.title: Robert Pattinson a revelation in paedophile thriller
data.description: VENICE - British star Robert Pattinson will look to extend his stellar 2026 box office run by playing a creepy paedophile-hunting TV presenter in “Primetime”, which premieres at the Venice Film Festival on Saturday.

data.title: Working class heroes
data.description: <p>The Japanese roots band Minyo Crusaders burst onto the international music scene in 2017 with their delightful album Echoes Of Japan on P-Vine Records.</p>

data.title: A dim spark
data.description: <p>Looking out from the balcony of a 300-year-old fireworks factory, three teenagers ponder the future of their coastal hometown as a redevelopment project threatens to cut through the land. A New Dawn follows their race against time to set off the family's "magical" firework. Despite being a visual feat, the anime lacks narrative momentum to move it forward.</p>

data.title: Lisa’s new single goes viral on release day
data.description: Lisa’s new song, SaWaDika , has drawn more than 8 million viewers on the first day of its release.

data.title: 'Wallace & Gromit' creators turn 50 with spook-tacular Shaun yarn
data.description: BRISTOL, United Kingdom — Crochet hook in hand, the animator slightly raises the eyelid of a clay model sheep in a filmmaking technique as old as cinema, perfected over five decades by Aardman Animations.

data.title: The Whisper Man isn't much to shout about
data.description: <p>New Netflix film The Whisper Man tries to play in the mystery-thriller genre with a stellar cast that includes Robert De Niro, Michael Keaton, Michelle Monaghan and Adam Scott. It is also based on the best-selling novel of the same name by Alex North.</p>

data.title: Learning to let go
data.description: <p>Parking a pickup by the roadside, an old man, a girl and a black dog catch sight of bats flying across the sky until the last light goes out. Like a camera, Regretfully At Dawn captures this ephemeral moment between the vanishing present and the emerging future and the process of letting go in such a tender, yet powerful way when a new season of life comes around.</p>

data.title: BIGBANG  to blow up  Bangkok
data.description: <p>It has been nine years since BIGBANG's last world tour. To celebrate their 20th anniversary, the K-pop legends are bringing "BIGBANG 2026-2027 World Tour &lt; XX : Cosmos &gt;" to 19 cities including Goyang, Oakland, Paris, London, Tokyo, Jakarta, Singapore and Bangkok.</p>

data.title: Seating collapse halts Thai rockers’ farewell show
data.description: Music fans attending a farewell concert by the legendary Thai rock band Asanee & Wasan were sent home before they could even say their goodbyes after part of a temporary elevated VIP seating structure collapsed.

data.title: Hender Scheme and Artek releases shoes for stools
data.description: From being fashion’s favoured stool to now getting its own pair of shoes, Artek’s iconic Finnish-designed Stool 60 is getting a new look through a collaboration collection with Japanese leather artisan brand Hender Scheme.

data.title: New movies out this week: Sept 3-9
data.description: Eight new titles to hit cinemas in Thailand this week.

data.title: Satisfy opens Paris flagship(s)
data.description: After gaining serious momentum globally in recent years, the high-end running and lifestyle brand Satisfy is returning to its Parisian roots with its first permanent flagship store — or rather, two.

data.title: George Lucas unveils art galaxy at his new LA museum
data.description: LOS ANGELES (UNITED STATES) - George Lucas, the legendary creator of the "Star Wars" saga, on Wednesday showcased his long-awaited Museum of Narrative Art, the culmination of nearly two decades of work and numerous obstacles.
